6. Per contra, application is vehemently opposed by counsel for the State.
It is submitted by counsel for the State that in case if the applicant is allowed to resume his duties, then there is every possibility that he would manipulate the official record.
It is further submitted that the custodial interrogation of the applicant is necessary.

7. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
8.

Rs.29,69,839/ but has also expressed his willingness that in case if he is not placed under suspension then he would not resume his duties and would file an application for his transfer and till his application is decided, he shall remain on leave and would not touch any file.

sentences.text:
In view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Ramesh Kumar (supra) as well as in view of the willingness expressed by the applicant, this Court is of considered opinion that the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail can be considered considered in the light of willingness expressed by the applicant.
10.

Accordingly, it is directed that on depositing an amount of Rs.29,69,839/- and on filing original copy of receipt thereof as well as on submitting an undertaking before the CJM, Mandla that in case if he is not suspended, then he would make an application for his transfer and till his application is decided, he would not resume his duties and would not touch any file and would remain on leave,
and if the applicant appears before Investigating Investig Officer on or before 228/08/2024 and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:40381 JBP:40381 the Investigating Officer, then he shall be released on anticipatory bail bail.
(CJM, Mandla shall retain the undertaking given by the applicant and would forward a copy of the same to the Investigating Officer for keeping it in the case diary).
diary)
11.

It is made clear that in case if the amount is not deposited or the undertaking is not given giv before the CJM, Mandla or the applicant does not appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 28/08/2024, then this order of anticipatory bail shall automatically stand cancelled cancelled.
12. In the light of judgment passed by the Supreme Court in the case of XYZ and Others Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh and Another reported in (2021) 16 SCC 179, 179, intimation regarding grant of bail be sent to the complainant.
13.
